scope: Inline citation markers and Local Knowledge citation chips for PDF preview entry points.

checks.evidence: Rendered as a native button with aria-label 'Open PDF preview for citation [n]' and keyboard focus via :focus-visible.
Rendered [n] text remains plain text when no matching structured citation affordance exists.
Blocked marker is aria-disabled, exposes 'PDF preview unavailable', and does not call active authorization.
Chip exposes an explicit 'Open PDF' label and opens through the shared verified preview controller.
Recoverable chip exposes 'Recover PDF' and still calls the active authorization/session flow.
Blocked chip is aria-disabled, carries safe unavailable copy, and does not create a session.

gate: Keyboard-discoverable controls, explicit non-color-only labels, visible focus token usage, and non-activatable blocked states covered by focused unit tests.
